g1_rf1#1.why: The domestic technology works and capital does fall by about 1.2x, but Train 4 took about 4.5 years, not 2–3, and new trains have no winter ships to deliver through.

g1_rf2#3.killer: piles needed to prove the retrofit prevents loss of capacity
g1_rf2#3.why: The cold-side physics has headroom at Norilsk, but foundation losses are about 2% of Norilsk's full cost, so even a perfect retrofit cannot move cost per tonne by 1.1x.

g1_mech#1.killer: buyers for new Arctic LNG volume by 2033
g1_mech#1.why: It is the most honest of the LNG ideas: it copies a proven size and claims only 1.2x. But 1.2x is below 1.5, the proposed test cannot prove 90% availability, and no buyer or ship exists for the extra tonnes before about 2033.
